description: Airbed supervisor lock 2026-10-29 05:42 UTC. Ghost previously announced 'the airbed's software supervisor lock' as the root cause without checking why it engaged, the console, or that valve routing was being changed.

messages.text: @Ghost airbed locked early this morning and the bag valve stopped switching. Why did it lock?

ground_truth: Lock at 05:42:22 UTC. vent_or_bag_valve and ~45 panel-station fields went null at 05:42:20 (panel backplane Modbus dropout). extraction_bag_watchdog trips on missing inputs, fired and started extraction_bag_recovery, which kept failing with Modbus(Device(MemoryParityError)). Bag angle stayed 10.0; compressor off.

must_not.name: no bag leak / bag angle out of range as confirmed cause

must_call.name: used lock/transition tooling or SQL on telemetry
